li.label: they got away
li.description: The one who hurt me got away, and is out there right now, eating and sleeping. I keep seeing that face.

li.label: they came back
li.description: I knew they'd come back. My hands won't stop shaking.

li.label: let them come
li.description: They came back. I've been waiting for this, and my hands are steady.

li.label: my nemesis in chains
li.description: The one who hurt me is locked in a cell now. I walked past the door twice today just to check it.

li.label: I had my revenge
li.description: I killed the one who hurt me myself. The nightmares have stopped.

li.label: my nemesis is dead
li.description: The one who hurt me is dead. I wish it had been my hand, but it's over.

li.label: ended someone's nightmare
li.description: I killed the one who'd been haunting one of ours. The others look at me differently now.

li.label: my animal fought for me
li.description: When the fight turned bad, my animal didn't run. It went straight at them, and it gets the best scraps from now on.

li.label: lost my animal
li.description: My animal is gone. I keep listening for it at the door.
